title: Common-stage transport of projection comparison equations
statement: Fix finite-field datum D and coefficient datum C. Let H be SixFunctorCommonStages D C [def-sf-operation-stages]. Suppose that each finite coefficient field stage (H.coefficientStages E0).rational satisfies CompactSupportProjectionCoherence on every second input. Then H.commonStage, with exactly H.commonStageTensor and H.commonStageExchange, satisfies the same four equations on every second input [def-sf-projection-comparison-equations]. This conclusion asserts neither invertibility nor naturality.

source.place: Compatibility and finite/common coefficient-field paragraphs, together with the coherence sentence of fix-prop-projection-formula

proof.text: Transport the pentagon through the coefficient comparison. For the left path, use naturality of the final support comparison and the two binary composition squares; for the right path, use the two other composition squares and naturality of the target compositor. Both paths have the same threefold endpoint comparison. Apply inclusion to the rational pentagon and cancel the outer support-comparison isomorphism. Every common-stage pair is literally the inclusion of its own-stage object, so this proves the pentagon for every input, including the transported composite compactification.

For the compactification, composition and proper equations, uncurry the specified projection mate into a natural transformation. The proper counit mate is likewise an uncurried natural transformation. Compose and whisker these with the retained support and pullback comparisons to obtain each side of each equation as a natural transformation between the same functors on the product of the two input categories. The finite-model equations are the three cited lemmas.

Choose the finite coefficient compositum of the two input stages. Its two isoToStage isomorphisms give an isomorphism in the product category from the original pair to the pair of included enlarged models. Naturality of the two sides and cancellation of the target functor image of this isomorphism transport each finite-model equality back to the original inputs. Assemble these three equalities with the proved pentagon.

proof_origin.place: Direct pentagon transport, naturality and common-stage presentation; finite-model equations split by their three independent clauses

lean.statement:
theorem compactSupportProjectionCoherence_common
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    (H : SixFunctorCommonStages D C)
    (hH : ∀ E₀ : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields C.l C.Qbar,
      CompactSupportProjectionCoherence (H.coefficientStages E₀).rational
        (H.coefficientStages E₀).rationalTensor (H.coefficientStages E₀).rationalExchange
        (fun _ _ ↦ True)) :
    CompactSupportProjectionCoherence H.commonStage H.commonStageTensor H.commonStageExchange
      (fun _ _ ↦ True)
